methodology: Action-by-action first research scan of continuous online text Mueller 1955 fifth-edition-labelled witness (EWTN HTML lines 122-317), and Rev. George A. Kelly 1959 chapter 16 (EWTN lines 1477-1549). Every source record has a single specific online line locator; multiple distinct described actions may be sourced from one line, including intra-paragraph variants. No invented original book pagination; no claim of exhaustive original edition review. Labels paraphrase briefly and never reproduce recipes, hymns or prayers. Some actions are an author's proposed domestic activities, not reported historical traditions. Older ritual/bishop or 1962 validity NOT presumed. Source text may borrow from Weiser Stokes Mueller or other authors; further provenance review required.
